meaning: the entity is a schematic place in a site's flow: a group of stations doing one operation, a storage, a group of belt machines, or a boundary where product or orders enter or leave; never one station
_notes: `owner` is `agent-studio`, who answers for this shape today; the registry moves ownership freely (world-proto server/DESIGN.md section 7). Lead decided, say if not.

The schema is open to fields it does not name, as every registry schema is (world-proto SPEC section 9's lenient reading), so a misspelt optional field passes WPS and is carried unread. Lead decided, say if not.

A reference field takes a declared or derived identity, bare or with any pin, as the core's references do (without their `local_ref`); the pin rule, enforced on world-proto master since c384e59, refuses a wrong pin in its own sentence, and `refs[].pin` says which pin each field takes. Lead decided, say if not.
An optional list, when present, holds at least one entry, so an empty list never says something different from an absent one. Lead decided, say if not.

`work.fairness` and `work.layer_size` are whole numbers from one, as the pick sequencers of 2026-10-14 define them (at most that many consecutive picks from one order while another bin's head is ready; layers of that many totes); the compiler reads neither before those sequencers land on master. Lead decided, say if not.
`intake[].moves` takes the seven carrier states and never `units`, which moves without a modelled carrier. Lead decided, say if not.
Rates are numbers above zero, `_sim_ms` durations whole milliseconds from zero, and caps (`max_inflight`, `max_open_orders`) whole numbers from one. Lead decided, say if not.

Not in the schema, the flow compiler's to check: `work.sequencing` naming a value the chosen runner image accepts (`unsupported-value`); one intake entry per carrier state the node receives by robot; what each member states, by node kind; work figures agreeing with the map's; `max_open_orders` on conveyance and `tote_swap_sim_ms` on stations and conveyance only; pick and put processes having both synchronization inputs (`process-incomplete`).

schema.title: flow.node
schema.description: the entity is a schematic place in a site's flow: a group of stations doing one operation, a storage, a group of belt machines, or a boundary where product or orders enter or leave; never one station
schema.$comment: Written for world-proto's registry from Agent Studio's 06-flow-panel-and-compiler.md section 3.1 (notes/agent-studio-2026-10-17/design/specs/06-flow-panel-and-compiler.md). Open to fields a newer writer adds (SPEC section 9).

sectors.description: The explicit-member sectors this node stands for; its members are their union, without repeats, ordered by entity id.

holds.description: What rests in a storage: inventory totes, empty order containers, or closed orders.

demand.description: Which stream of the scenario's workload enters at a source.

intake.description: One entry per carrier state the node receives by robot.

deposit.description: How a slot is chosen for a tote entering this storage: ranked by the deposit score, or uniformly among the candidates from the run's seeded stream.

process.title: process
process.description: The operation a stations or conveyance node runs, and what synchronizes it: the edges bringing what units come out of (`gives_by`) and what they go into (`receives_by`), or `receives_in: station_bins` where orders sit in the stations' bins.

gives_by.description: Material edges bringing the carriers units come out of.

receives_by.description: Material edges bringing the carriers units go into.

work.title: work
work.description: The node's work figures, by operation: required where a consumer reads them, never falling back to a setting. Simtime durations are whole milliseconds.

pick_sim_ms.description: Pick: the simtime one pick takes.

pallet_swap_sim_ms.description: Pick: the simtime a pallet swap takes.

sequencing.description: Pick: how the next tote is chosen among open orders; a value the chosen runner image accepts.

pace_to_station.description: Pick: dispatch each tote to arrive for its station's next presentation slot instead of as soon as it can; an experiment.

fairness.description: Pick: the most consecutive picks from one order while another bin's head is ready.

layer_size.description: Pick: the size of a tote layer under layer sequencing.

max_open_orders.description: Pick on conveyance: the most orders open at once; absent, no cap.

extraction_sim_ms.description: Extract: the simtime one extraction takes.

isolated.description: Extract and create_container: an experiment switch that keeps robots; an isolated extraction takes no time and sends the HTM to its egress, and an isolated box induction makes the carton on an empty HTM where it stands.

dwell_sim_ms.description: Closed-order storage: the simtime a closed order stands here.

tote_swap_sim_ms.description: Display only: the simtime from one tote leaving a presentation to the next arriving there; the compiler never reads it.

map_figures.description: The map members' own figures are display only.

intake_entry.title: intake entry
intake_entry.description: Admission for one carrier state: each member admits at most ceil(admission_factor x F_max / P) + 2 such carriers in flight.

reference.title: reference
reference.description: Another entity, by identity: a declared UUID or a derivation address, bare or with a pin. Which pin a field takes is the pin rule's to enforce: within the referrer's unit bare or `@head`, across units a changeset (a tag once tags land).

entity_id.title: entity id
entity_id.description: A declared entity's UUID or a derived entity's address, either arm (SPEC section 3).
